original_test_intent: Set the front-panel button enable/disable mask, prove each affected physical control state, and restore the prior mask.
original_method: Preserved source uses invalid 0x06/0x0A/no-data; corrected execution requires approved 0x00/0x0A plus one validated mask byte.
manual_activity: Owner approves the exact mask and witnesses power/reset/diagnostic/standby button behavior and restoration.
safety_requirements: Do not disable only recovery path
agent_execution_scope: Perform write only with separate approval
engineer_actions: Judge physical behavior and DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly notes missing exact bytes but does not fix the invalid NetFn or define mask evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval use Chassis 0x00/0x0A with one reserved-bit-clean mask, verify status/physical effect, then restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Invalid source bytes, Script and timing are retained as source evidence, not executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture current button capability/status, apply one approved mask with corrected command, test each changed control safely, read back and restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects NetFn and required payload in Review layer only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion without mask readback and physical checks does not validate the setter.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or unrestored mask can remove local recovery controls.

project_override_considerations: A vendor UI/API is equivalent only if it maps every source button bit and proves readback, physical behavior and restoration.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires Chassis Set Front Panel Button Enables, but source uses Application NetFn 0x06 and omits the mandatory mask byte.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended function is clear and the corrected standard contract is identifiable; approval and physical setup are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents execution of an invalid no-data command and adds mask, behavior and restoration coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: The mask changes multiple independent service controls, so success must be evaluated per bit against both readback and the actual front panel. Preserving an independent OOB path is mandatory because the tested mask may deliberately disable local recovery buttons.
